visual_review.notes: Autonomously reviewed all 248 original chronological video frames, enlarged anatomy/alpha and loop seams, then actual Godot native overview at gameplay scale. Idle has visible two-arm crossbow lowering and return with planted feet; walking has reciprocal leg contacts, clear boot separation, stable two-handed rigid crossbow and cloth follow-through. Fixed ground anchor and original .4 source scale retained. Candidate186 checks passed, including Normal/Fast/reduced-motion. Review used ordered frames and native renders, not continuous browser playback or manual playtest. Preserve six previously accepted actions.
